issues.finding: Only deterministic postcapture cost minimization is implemented here. Figure 1/model name includes broader GHG/stochastic/multiobjective capabilities; only aggregate Equation 1 is printed.
issues.action: Do not attribute a Pareto frontier, stochastic policy, storage-maximization objective or complete LCA to this implementation. Obtain actual constraints/domains/code.

issues.finding: Fifteen plotted labels equal three bases plus twelve alternatives, not fifteen alternatives plus bases. Table 1 omits standalone storage-delay z, later present in Table 2/plots.
issues.action: Preserve all labels and their baseline groups; do not invent extra scenarios or treat alternatives as probabilistic events.

issues.finding: Yara/Norcem numbering reverses in Figure 3; map hubs 11/12 differ from prose 10/11; UKfield 36 omitted in caption; NLtrip heatmap refers to base case 1 rather than 2.
issues.action: Resolve exact native node/route and plotting map before source-specific annual reconstruction; missing 8 not supplied by assumption.

issues.finding: Table 2 repeats−4.8%growth levelized endpoints and prints positive descending 5.8→1.3%unit endpoints despite mixed-sign plot/writing. Discount and total/unit/levelized denominators unprovided.
issues.action: Keep printed ranges literal. Optionality constrains the same minimized objective, not every differently discounted metric; obtain native cash flows/mass before declaring errors.

issues.finding: Only endpoints and 333.8 Mt total are stated; appendix UK first-year curve appears below 1000 kt rather than 2016 kt. Growth/delay start, increment and truncation mapping unknown.
issues.action: Retain apparent graph/index question without exact pixel invention. Do not fit thirty native annual inputs or infer probabilities from deterministic what-ifs.

issues.finding: One-cargo sizing and annual ship/trip counts lack time-resolved arrivals, capacity mix, load, weather/downtime and inventory proof. Annual well metric is named without a supplied series.
issues.action: Use disclosed gap LP only to show conditional insufficiency of a cargo rule; no native tank, fleet, well or dispatch model is reproduced.

issues.finding: Postcapture regional analogues and geological cost models do not supply pressure-constrained annual service, actual permits, complete capture utilities or permanent-retention/avoidedGHG inventories.
issues.action: Retain native geography/scenario boundaries. No cost saving, handled mass, model-family intensity or reliability factor enters accepted operating/GHG inputs.
